text.p: The average yield at the latest auction of three-month discount treasury rose to 56.88 percent from 51.30 percent at the last sale on November 19, a central bank statement said on Thursday.
The results of Thursday auction, compared to the last issue
of three-month discount T-bills, were as follows:
Amount sold 84.786 million UAH 13.592 million UAH
Actual amount raised 74.254 million UAH 12.051 million UAH Average yield 56.88 pct 51.30 pct
The central bank sold 847,865 T-bills, the bank's statement said.
The date of the next auction of three-month discount T-bills is unfixed.
The average yield at the latest auction of six-month discount treasury bills rose to 59.90 percent from 57.56 percent at the last sale on November 19, a central bank statement said.
The results of Thursday's auction, compared to the last issue of six-month discount T-bills, were as follows:
Amount sold 36.837 million UAH 13.038 million UAH
Actual amount raised 28.365 million UAH 10.131 million UAH
The central bank sold 368,378 T-bills, the bank's statement said.
The date of the next auction of six-month discount T-bills is unfixed.
The average yield at the latest auction of nine-month discount treasury bills rose to 58.45 percent from 58.26 percent at the last sale on November 19, a central bank statement said.
The results of Thursday's auction, compared to the last issue of nine-month discount T-bills, were as follows:
The central bank sold 1,748 T-bills, the bank's statement
The date of the next auction of nine-month discount T-bills is unfixed.
